Security, reliability and wording fixes from reviews 4 to 6.

- Pull review reads commands the way they run: exec-form hooks keep their arguments, command lines are split on shell operators at any nesting depth, and a swap between an exec-form hook and a shell command line is shown
- The "from another OS" warning checks only the program and the scripts a command runs, and shows the command as written
- Restore warnings and bundle paths are printed on one line, so a file name cannot fake extra output
- A file login saved while the keychain failed now wins over the older keychain login
- Pull records a revision as partial when files were left out; push says the last pull "did not restore everything" and suggests a plain `agentnomad pull`
- Push remembers a project name only after the project is saved
- A failed marketplace add explains why, naming the claude.ai admin console when a policy blocks it
- Server: download limit (600 an hour per account), one shared storage rule, safer key checks
- README pitch, install and feedback lines, and issue templates

Install or update: `npm install -g agentnomad@latest` (Node.js 22.13 or newer).
